newsitem.title: USA: Samsung found to infringe patent.
newsitem.headline: Samsung found to infringe patent.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Electronics Co Ltd said on Monday that the U.S. International Trade Commission found that Samsung infringed upon Sandisk Corp's U.S. patent for flash memory.
The commission also overturned a separate determination by an administrative law judge, who had ruled that Samsung's flash memory chips infringed upon another Sandisk patent.
Samsung said in a statement that it was unable to settle its patent litigation dispute prior to the ITC's findings.
Samsung said a limited exclusion order issued by the ITC involves only Samsung's sales of flash memory chips and their carriers in the U.S.
The order does not include Samsung's or other companies' downstream products that use or incorporate Samsung flash memory chips, Samsung said.
Samsung said it will appeal the ITC ruling and order to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.

Samsung also will vigorously pursue the suit it filed against Sandisk in the U.S. Federal District Court in Oakland. Samsung is seeking an injunction against Sandisk's flash memory products together with an accounting for damages, it said.
